typeDescription: A sustainable, enveloping life-force aura. Waiting for something to respond to channels Sacral energy into deeply satisfying work.
aura: Open and enveloping. The field reaches out and wraps around whatever it meets, drawing work, people, and opportunity close enough for the Sacral to give them a gut reply.
strategyDescription: Let life present something first, then read the gut reply to it. The Sacral commits its energy only to what it genuinely says yes to, so responding rather than initiating is what keeps the work sustainable instead of frustrating.
authorityDescription: Decisions are made by the gut response of the defined Sacral, a binary yes or no that arrives in the body before the mind assembles a reason for it. The response is immediate rather than deliberative, and it needs something concrete to respond to, so it answers real questions and real options in the moment and stays silent in front of blank speculation. The trap is arguing the body out of its own answer with logic, obligation, or the reasoning that an opportunity is too good to decline, which spends life force on work the Sacral never said yes to.

profileKeynotes.personality: Hermit: a natural talent that emerges when called out by others.
profileKeynotes.design: Opportunist: influence and opportunity flow through an established network.

profileDescription: Hermit over Opportunist. A conscious need for withdrawal, where a natural talent matures unobserved, sits against an unconscious network that keeps calling that talent back out into use. The pull between hiding and being wanted is the design itself, not a fault in it: solitude is the condition for the gift, and the call from the network is what turns a private gift into a role.
definitionDescription: The defined centers fall into two groups with no channel between them, so energy is consistent inside each group and does not cross the divide. The gap is bridged by the gates other people carry, which is why particular company can make thinking suddenly feel joined up, and why that company is easily mistaken for completion rather than recognized as a temporary bridge. What the configuration needs is time for the two areas to synthesize and awareness of who is bridging them, not a rushed decision taken while the halves are still speaking separately.

sides.personality: The conscious side, printed in black and calculated at the moment of birth. These activations are the mind and the sense of self: what the person recognizes as their own and can describe to someone else.
sides.design: The unconscious side, printed in red and calculated 88 degrees of solar arc before birth, roughly three months earlier. These activations run the body and are visible to other people long before the mind admits them.

incarnationCross.name: Right Angle Cross of Laws 2
incarnationCross.description: The storyteller speaking about how things ought to be ordered. A vision of better rules is told with conviction and with very little interest in the detail of building them.

centers.name: Head
centers.theme: Consistent mental pressure and inspiration. A reliable source of questions, doubt, and ideas worth exploring.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Is this question worth answering, and is it even mine? The open Head amplifies the mental pressure of others and spends itself resolving questions that do not matter to it.
centers.biology: The pineal gland. Its melatonin secretion governs the sleep and wake cycle, and in the bodygraph this gland is the source of the pressure to think.

centers.name: Ajna
centers.theme: A fixed way of processing and conceptualizing. Mental certainty and a consistent thinking style.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Is this certainty real, or is it a fixed opinion held in order to feel safe? The open Ajna pretends to be sure and defends beliefs it does not actually hold.
centers.biology: The pituitary gland, anterior and posterior. This master endocrine gland directs the other glands, and in the bodygraph it carries conceptual processing and mental awareness.

centers.name: Throat
centers.theme: Consistent expression and the ability to manifest through speech and action when connected to a motor.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Is all this talking and doing an attempt to attract attention? The open Throat fills the silence and stays busy to be noticed, rather than waiting to be recognized and asked.
centers.biology: The thyroid and parathyroid glands. Thyroid hormones set the metabolic rate and the parathyroids regulate calcium, and in the bodygraph this pair governs the timing of speech and action.

centers.name: G Center
centers.theme: Searches for direction and identity through environment and people. Thrives in the right place with the right company.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Are love and a direction being hunted from the outside? The open G borrows an identity from whoever is present and mistakes the searching itself for a destination.
centers.biology: The liver and the blood. The liver processes nutrients and regulates what the blood carries, and in the bodygraph it holds identity, direction, and love.

centers.name: Heart
centers.theme: Inconsistent willpower. Learns there is nothing to prove and avoids overcommitting to win approval.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Is there something to prove here? The open Heart overcommits and makes promises that inconsistent willpower cannot keep, then reads the broken promise as proof of low worth.
centers.biology: The heart, stomach, gallbladder, and thymus gland. This cluster drives circulation, digestion, and immune maturation, and in the bodygraph it fuels willpower and the pursuit of value.

centers.name: Sacral
centers.theme: Sustainable life force and work energy. A reliable gut response that guides what to engage with.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Is enough ever enough? The open Sacral amplifies life force that is not its own and keeps working past its limit until exhaustion finally forces the stop.
centers.biology: The ovaries and the testes. These gonads produce the sex hormones behind fertility and vitality, and in the bodygraph they supply the life force that powers work.

centers.name: Solar Plexus
centers.theme: Absorbs and amplifies the emotions of others. Learns to recognize which feelings are not its own.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Is the truth being avoided in order to keep the peace? The open Solar Plexus absorbs and magnifies the emotion in the room, then dodges confrontation to make the discomfort stop.
centers.biology: The kidneys, the pancreas, and the nervous system. These regulate fluid balance, blood sugar, and nerve signaling, and in the bodygraph they carry the chemistry of the emotional wave.

centers.name: Spleen
centers.theme: A consistent instinctual awareness of health, timing, and safety. Spontaneous in-the-moment knowing.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Is something unhealthy being held on to out of fear? The open Spleen clings to people, work, and habits well past their time, because letting go registers as a threat to survival.
centers.biology: The spleen, the lymphatic system, and immune function. They filter the blood and mount the immune response, and in the bodygraph this is the oldest awareness, tracking health, timing, and survival.

centers.name: Root
centers.theme: A consistent way of handling pressure and stress. A steady drive to get things done and move forward.
centers.notSelfQuestion: Is this hurry an attempt to be free of pressure? The open Root rushes to finish in order to escape a pressure it amplified from others, and the relief it is chasing never arrives.
centers.biology: The adrenal glands. They secrete adrenaline and cortisol to drive the stress response, and in the bodygraph they supply the pressure and the fuel to get things moving.

channels.name: Logic
channels.description: Doubt in the Head presses the Ajna to formulate an answer. This is where the logical process starts: questioning whether a pattern still holds, then reaching for the formula that would prove it.
channels.circuitDescription: Sharing for the species, carried by 14 channels. Pattern and experience are worked into something transmissible: the logical half tests patterns and projects them forward, the abstract half harvests wisdom from experience already lived.

channels.name: Structuring
channels.description: A knowing in the Ajna arrives whole and without explanation, and the Throat has to find language for it. Timing decides whether it lands as genius or as noise.
channels.circuitDescription: Empowerment through mutation, carried by 15 channels. The knowing here cannot be explained or handed over, only lived, and it changes other people by exposure rather than instruction. It arrives as a pulse, never on demand.

channels.name: Preservation
channels.description: Sacral nourishment is directed by Splenic values. Care is provided for the young and the vulnerable, and the instinct keeps guard over which values are still worth preserving.
channels.circuitDescription: Support and resources, carried by 7 channels. This is the group that feeds, defends, and reproduces itself, trading willpower, care, and material goods on terms that have to stay fair or the bargain breaks.

channels.name: Mutation
channels.description: Root limitation and Sacral ordering pulse against each other. Change builds up under constraint and releases in bursts that cannot be scheduled, the source of mutation in the bodygraph.
channels.circuitDescription: Empowerment through mutation, carried by 15 channels. The knowing here cannot be explained or handed over, only lived, and it changes other people by exposure rather than instruction. It arrives as a pulse, never on demand.

gates.gateDescription: The storyteller at the throat. It stimulates an audience with the ideas of gate 11 dressed in lived experience, and the telling matters more than the accuracy of every detail.
gates.lineMeaning: A natural storyteller who has to be asked. The talent stimulates only once it is called out, and until it is recognized the stories are told to nobody.
gates.planetDescription: The dominant activation. With the Earth it carries roughly 70 percent of the imprint on the chart. The Personality Sun gate is the conscious life theme, the Design Sun is the radiance the body broadcasts before a word is spoken.

gates.gateDescription: Root pressure held inside a limit. Mutation happens here, but only once the limitation is accepted, and the pulse of change refuses to be scheduled.
gates.lineMeaning: An innate sense of which restraints are real. It waits inside the limit without struggling against it, and it moves the instant a genuine opening appears.
gates.planetDescription: Always the wheel-opposite of the Sun, so it is derived rather than observed. It grounds whatever the Sun expresses, and the two Suns plus the two Earths fix the four gates of the incarnation cross.

gates.gateDescription: Instinctive recall of how a person behaved before. Splenic pattern recognition scanning for whether someone is a resource or a risk, so the past decides whether the deal is safe.
gates.lineMeaning: Foundation: the instinct that reads a person on contact and sets the terms of dealing with them. Terms softened for the sake of harmony are the ones that come back as a problem.
gates.planetDescription: The fastest body on the wheel, crossing it in about 28 days. It carries drive and the ongoing motion of the form, and it sets the timing for Lunar authority, which needs a full cycle before clarity arrives.

gates.gateDescription: The voice that says I lead. Democratic by nature, so the leadership is real only when the group recognizes it, and only when it carries the direction of gate 7 behind it.
gates.lineMeaning: Leadership is projected onto this line and direction is awaited. The outcome is seen in advance, and the standing question is whether it is leading or merely being led.
gates.planetDescription: Geometry rather than personality. It marks the direction life turns toward in the second half, after the midlife transition, and on the Design side it names the environment in which the form is seen correctly.

gates.gateDescription: Root pressure that starts the experiential cycle. Energy contracts into a hunger for a feeling not yet had, which is the fantasy gate 30 then sets out to pursue.
gates.lineMeaning: Recognition arrives from outside and finally gives the fantasy somewhere to go. Persistent dissatisfaction with the limit sours the fuel even when the support to use it is offered.
gates.planetDescription: The familiar geometry of the first half of life, the ground the person operates from before the midlife turn. On the Design side it names the environment the body already knows and returns to by default.

gates.gateDescription: Mental energy for answering. It converts the doubt pressed down by gate 63 into a possible formula, and that answer stays a hypothesis awaiting proof rather than a verified fact.
gates.lineMeaning: The answer is claimed before it is held, then chased down fast enough to make the claim true. It works often enough to become a method, and time collects on the occasions it does not.
gates.planetDescription: The communication imprint. The Personality Mercury gate is the message the person is here to deliver, the Design Mercury gate is how that expression actually sounds to everyone else.

gates.gateDescription: Head pressure from unresolved images of the past. The mind is crowded with fragments that do not yet fit, and gate 47 is where they finally resolve into meaning.
gates.lineMeaning: The pressure of unresolved images is met by sorting them. Order is found inside the confusion, and acting the instant the fog seems to lift is the standing error.
gates.planetDescription: Values and the moral floor under behavior. Personality Venus is what is consciously held dear, Design Venus is the standard the body applies without ever being consulted.

gates.gateDescription: Root pressure that starts the experiential cycle. Energy contracts into a hunger for a feeling not yet had, which is the fantasy gate 30 then sets out to pursue.
gates.lineMeaning: Recognition arrives from outside and finally gives the fantasy somewhere to go. Persistent dissatisfaction with the limit sours the fuel even when the support to use it is offered.
gates.planetDescription: Immature energy: raw drive that has not yet learned its own timing. It shows where action gets forced before it is ripe, and it only matures when strategy and authority are running the decision.

gates.gateDescription: Creative individuality looking for form. Sitting in the G center, it supplies the raw originality that gate 8 carries to the throat, where it becomes a contribution others can see.
gates.lineMeaning: The creative impulse answers to timing rather than to will, so the foundation here is patience. Forcing the work into being on demand only destabilizes it.
gates.planetDescription: Expansion, and the law that rewards living correctly. Personality Jupiter marks where growth and abundance gather, Design Jupiter marks the protection the form receives while it stays aligned.

gates.gateDescription: Root energy pushing for joy and improvement. The zest for life is the fuel behind correction, and when it is blocked the vitality sours into bitterness.
gates.lineMeaning: Joy is grounded in the plain fact of being alive. Root vitality is stable because it rests on appreciation rather than on anything that has to be arranged first.
gates.planetDescription: Discipline through restriction, the corrective imprint. It is where consequences arrive when the design is not honored, and its returns near ages 29 and 58 are when that account gets settled.

gates.gateDescription: Sacral energy for nourishing and protecting others. It is tribal, aimed at family and group rather than at humanity, and without limits it turns into overextension.
gates.lineMeaning: Care begins with the body that provides it. Putting the needs of others first without a foundation of self nourishment is the fastest route to being taken for granted.
gates.planetDescription: The unusual and the abrupt. It carries individuality and unexpected change, and its opposition near age 40 is the midlife pressure to live as oneself instead of as the conditioning.

ichingHexagram.english: The Corners of the Mouth (Providing Nourishment)

gates.gateDescription: Head pressure to doubt what is presented. Suspicion is where logic starts. The doubt belongs on the pattern rather than on people, and it presses gate 4 for a formula.
gates.lineMeaning: Doubt, then withdrawal, then perspective. Questions are held without urgency, and a resolution is accepted instead of being reopened forever.
gates.planetDescription: The veil. It carries spiritual perception and the capacity for illusion in equal measure, so whatever it activates is rarely seen plainly, by the person or by anyone watching.

gates.gateDescription: Root drive to rise. The ambition is aimed at material and social transformation, and it advances by being recognized from above rather than by pushing from below.
gates.lineMeaning: Ambition, then disillusion, then selectivity. It stops climbing for the sake of climbing and keeps only the connections that carry weight in both directions.
gates.planetDescription: Truth through transformation. It exposes what was hidden and forces the psychological change that follows, working generationally and slowly rather than personally and quickly.

gates.gateDescription: Sacral energy for starting something new and forcing it into order. The impulse is mutative and arrives in pulses, so stalling before the breakthrough is part of the natural rhythm here.
gates.lineMeaning: An unconscious magnetism that draws in the guidance the mutation needs to survive. The pull works while it is not being worked, and it collapses the moment demands are made of it.
gates.planetDescription: The dominant activation. With the Earth it carries roughly 70 percent of the imprint on the chart. The Personality Sun gate is the conscious life theme, the Design Sun is the radiance the body broadcasts before a word is spoken.

gates.gateDescription: The instinctive guardian of the rules and values that keep a group intact. Splenic, so what is right for the tribe is felt rather than argued, and the responsibility is carried, not chosen.
gates.lineMeaning: Responsibility for values reaches the whole network. Surrounded by corrupted standards it has to hold its own, because whatever it tolerates becomes the norm for everyone attached to it.
gates.planetDescription: Always the wheel-opposite of the Sun, so it is derived rather than observed. It grounds whatever the Sun expresses, and the two Suns plus the two Earths fix the four gates of the incarnation cross.

gates.gateDescription: The tribal voice of ownership and distribution. It gathers people and resources, presides over what the group holds, and speaks with the authority of having.
gates.lineMeaning: Wisdom that knows how to take the outsider back in. It can make room for the eccentric who returns, or demand that returning means conforming, and only one of those grows the tribe.
gates.planetDescription: The fastest body on the wheel, crossing it in about 28 days. It carries drive and the ongoing motion of the form, and it sets the timing for Lunar authority, which needs a full cycle before clarity arrives.

gates.gateDescription: The voice of retreat and retelling. Experience has to be withdrawn from and digested in private before it can be spoken as a lesson the collective is able to use.
gates.lineMeaning: Withdrawal from the circle handled without drama. The network keeps its regard when the exit is clean, and the renewal is lost when the retreat is forced rather than chosen.
gates.planetDescription: Geometry rather than personality. It marks the direction life turns toward in the second half, after the midlife transition, and on the Design side it names the environment in which the form is seen correctly.

gates.gateDescription: Root pressure to secure the basics of belonging: food, shelter, touch, and support. It is acutely sensitive to what the tribe needs and presses gate 49 for a response.
gates.lineMeaning: Belonging is secured by keeping the group composed and informed. Disapproval from inside the network cuts deep here, and one turned back can collapse the whole sense of inclusion.
gates.planetDescription: The familiar geometry of the first half of life, the ground the person operates from before the midlife turn. On the Design side it names the environment the body already knows and returns to by default.

gates.gateDescription: Mental energy that forms opinions out of observed patterns. The opinion is a proposal for what will work, and it lands only when asked for and grounded in the detail of gate 62.
gates.lineMeaning: The opinion forms on its own out of selected company. Thinkers who keep a thread of thought moving are what draw this line out, and stale minds are quietly left alone.
gates.planetDescription: The communication imprint. The Personality Mercury gate is the message the person is here to deliver, the Design Mercury gate is how that expression actually sounds to everyone else.

gates.gateDescription: The voice that turns individual knowing into language others can grasp. Spoken at the wrong moment it sounds like nonsense, and at the right moment it sounds like genius.
gates.lineMeaning: Fragments are held until they combine into a new form. Neutrality under pressure from the status quo is what allows a genuinely new structure to be proposed at all.
gates.planetDescription: Values and the moral floor under behavior. Personality Venus is what is consciously held dear, Design Venus is the standard the body applies without ever being consulted.

gates.gateDescription: Root drive to rise. The ambition is aimed at material and social transformation, and it advances by being recognized from above rather than by pushing from below.
gates.lineMeaning: The network is the ladder. This is the rung where material ambition either transforms into something higher or collapses, once what was wanted turns out not to be worth having.
gates.planetDescription: Immature energy: raw drive that has not yet learned its own timing. It shows where action gets forced before it is ripe, and it only matures when strategy and authority are running the decision.

gates.gateDescription: Individual knowing that arrives whole and unexplained. Sitting in the Ajna, it is a breakthrough with no logic to defend it, and it needs gate 23 to become audible to anyone else.
gates.lineMeaning: A natural mental process, private and peculiar to itself, that keeps producing knowing. It breaks when the urge to speak arrives and the process it depends on gets abandoned.
gates.planetDescription: Expansion, and the law that rewards living correctly. Personality Jupiter marks where growth and abundance gather, Design Jupiter marks the protection the form receives while it stays aligned.

gates.gateDescription: Root energy pushing for joy and improvement. The zest for life is the fuel behind correction, and when it is blocked the vitality sours into bitterness.
gates.lineMeaning: Indulgence, then restraint, then measured delight. It enjoys what is on offer and still withdraws the moment its own integrity is the price of staying.
gates.planetDescription: Discipline through restriction, the corrective imprint. It is where consequences arrive when the design is not honored, and its returns near ages 29 and 58 are when that account gets settled.

gates.gateDescription: Sacral energy for starting something new and forcing it into order. The impulse is mutative and arrives in pulses, so stalling before the breakthrough is part of the natural rhythm here.
gates.lineMeaning: The most volatile line in the gate, sorting the fertile from the sterile by trying both. Mistakes are the mechanism here, and refusing to risk them is what actually ends the mutation.
gates.planetDescription: The unusual and the abrupt. It carries individuality and unexpected change, and its opposition near age 40 is the midlife pressure to live as oneself instead of as the conditioning.

gates.gateDescription: Head pressure to doubt what is presented. Suspicion is where logic starts. The doubt belongs on the pattern rather than on people, and it presses gate 4 for a formula.
gates.lineMeaning: Others rely on this line to find the crack in the system. It questions the framework rather than the people, and pressing the doubt where nobody asked wastes it.
gates.planetDescription: The veil. It carries spiritual perception and the capacity for illusion in equal measure, so whatever it activates is rarely seen plainly, by the person or by anyone watching.

gates.gateDescription: Head pressure to know the unknowable. Inspiration arrives as a why with no answer attached, and the design is to sit with the question rather than solve it.
gates.lineMeaning: Head pressure to know drives deep private study. The mystery is probed for its own sake, and the danger is a withdrawal so complete that nothing returns from it.
gates.planetDescription: Truth through transformation. It exposes what was hidden and forces the psychological change that follows, working generationally and slowly rather than personally and quickly.
